cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource
# worst-case shape: 256 streams, 4096 events, 2 MiB field octets, 8 MiB DATA
events = []
per = 16  # events per stream
n_streams = 256
field_pad = 1900  # octets of value per headers section -> 2 MiB total field octets
data_per_event = (8*1024*1024) // (n_streams * (per - 1))
for i in range(n_streams):
    sid = i * 4
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': [
        [':method', 'POST'], [':scheme', 'https'], [':authority', 'demo.test'],
        [':path', '/p%d' % i], ['content-length', '1'], ['x-pad', 'v'*field_pad],
        ['x-pad2', 'w'*field_pad]]})
    for k in range(per - 2):
        events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'data', 'hex': ('ab'*data_per_event)})
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': [['x-audit-n', 't'*200]]})
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'fin'})
print('events', len(events))
scen = {'routes': {'https://demo.test': 'rack'}, 'events': events}
blob = json.dumps(scen).encode()
print('input MiB %.1f' % (len(blob)/2**20))
t0 = time.time()
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/bridge.py'], input=blob,
                      stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
dt = time.time()-t0
print('rc', proc.returncode, 'wall %.2fs' % dt, 'stdout MiB %.1f' % (len(proc.stdout)/2**20))
out = json.loads(proc.stdout)
print('statuses', {s['status'] for s in out['streams']}, len(out['streams']))
raw = bytes.fromhex(out['origins']['rack'])
print('pipeline MiB %.1f' % (len(raw)/2**20))
print('child peak rss MiB %.0f' % (resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024))
